hypotheses.expected_sign: Preferred relative trading costs up, discount up
predictions: Relative spreads or price-impact proxies covary with discount
hypotheses.confidence: Trading activity plotted only; volume ratio does not establish relative liquidity; liquidity hypothesis untested

hypotheses.claim: Limited arbitrage allows class-price gaps to persist
